about: UX8-C: a graph whose curves share one unit carries metadata.legend_unit_on_axis; its legend names each curve WITHOUT the unit (the Y title carries it), the data keeps its units, and a legend rename still wins verbatim. Both legs read this table: frontend/src/lib/legendUnitOnAxis.test.ts (on-screen legend) and tests/test_export_legend_unit_on_axis.py (PDF/SVG export).
